utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, I'm organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood—collecting broken items to fix up. Want to help gather stuff from neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Jules! I'm happy to help collect items. What do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great! Could you start by knocking on doors on Maple Street and letting folks know we'll pick up small appliances and electronics this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's happening, but I can't remember when. Sorry, Ira, did you say the time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I don't think we set a time yet—remember, you forgot to check on it earlier. We should probably figure that out soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, I forgot to check! Sorry about that. Let's figure out the time now—what works for you?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure of the exact time, but Rosa mentioned it's on Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh great, Saturday at the community center. I'll look out for a flyer or check with Rosa for the time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I'll double-check with Rosa too and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate you setting this up, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem, Uli. Let's get started.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I'm ready. What's first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, do you know the exact time for the repair drive? I need to plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I've been wondering the same thing—who's actually organizing this? I haven't seen any official notice, so I'm not sure about times.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It's always at 10 AM sharp, as usual. I've been going for years, so I know the time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full set in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I might borrow a screwdriver for my lamp. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll set one aside for you. Let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Quinn, do you know when the repair drive is? Uli asked me to help with their fence.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's this Saturday! Want me to round up some other folks to help with Uli's fence?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would be great, thanks. Do you know if we still need nails and lumber for the fences?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Repair drive is Sunday at community center. Need volunteers for setup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I heard it's Sunday at the community center from Rosa. What time do you need setup volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Setup at 8 AM. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, do you know if we have enough extension cords? I'm worried we might come up short.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I think we have a good supply, but let me double-check my list. I'll make sure we're all set for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa. I just want to be sure we don't run into any surprises.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, it's next weekend! We're gathering supplies and tools at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great! So it is next weekend. I thought I saw something about it, but then I got it mixed up with that other thing. I'll try to remember to bring something.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Alright, I'll remind you closer to the day! We're meeting at the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Cleo, what's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Just got back from checking my bins—I've got a couple dozen screws and a few spools of wire. Should cover some basic needs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, do we have a list yet of what else we need, or are we just going by what we remember?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Tess, do we need to bring our own tools or parts for the repairs, or will they be provided?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think they'll have some basic tools on hand, but it's always good to bring your own if you've got them! And parts, well, you might want to bring whatever you're looking to fix.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good to know. So should I sign up beforehand, or can we just show up with our broken items?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, have you heard about the repair drive happening next weekend?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it's Sunday at the community center. Got the parts ready?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I think the parts are ready, but I should check with Pia to be sure everything's accounted for.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think so, but I can't remember the time... was it 10 or 11?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think I saw a flyer... but honestly, I can't even remember if it's this weekend or next. Time just slips away from me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Maybe we should go take a look at that flyer together? I'm sure it's around here somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, is the repair drive still on for this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, it's on! Eli said it starts at 10 AM sharp, as always.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll be there. Thanks for the info.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do you have a list of items that people are bringing in, Jules? I want to make sure we have the right tools and materials ready.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No set list yet, Hana! That's where you come in—just ask around and see what folks have broken, and we'll be ready for anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, I'll start asking neighbors what they need fixed. Maybe I can coordinate with Rey and Dane too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rey, I heard there's a repair drive happening? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think it's to fix up fences and stuff around the neighborhood. Uli asked me to help with his fence. Do you know when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure of the exact time, but Rosa mentioned it's on Saturday at the community center. I can check with her and let you know!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, I'm getting my materials list together for Cleo. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still need to know what time the repair drive starts on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Eli said it starts at 10 AM sharp, as always.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, Eli, I'll head to my bins and see what screws and spools I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, good. I'll be at the community center at 10 AM sharp. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Alright, Eli. I'll see you at the center with whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara! I'll bring those screwdrivers and pliers Saturday morning at 10. Anything else you need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's perfect, Gus! Thanks for helping out. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Mara. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll see you Sunday then, Rosa. Thanks for keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You're welcome, Uli! See you Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: See you Sunday, Rosa. Take care.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Pia, are you planning to join the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I want to, but I'm worried about whether we have enough supplies. Do you know?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus said he'll bring whatever we need, so supplies shouldn't be a problem. Want me to check with him?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, it's definitely a thing! Mara mentioned she's helping organize it. I think it's at the community center this Saturday, but I'm not sure about the start time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Mara? Huh. Well, I'll believe it when I see an actual flyer or something.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can grab a flyer from the community center later and show you, if you want.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Faye, any word on that repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes! It's on Saturday, and I'm coordinating a pickup for items on Tuesday if you need help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh great, thanks for the heads up! I might take you up on that pickup offer.
